أستيئس (form X)
# أَسْتَيْئِسُ (ʔastayʔisu) /ʔas.taj.ʔi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَيْئَسَ (istayʔasa)
# أَسْتَيْئِسَ (ʔastayʔisa) /ʔas.taj.ʔi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَيْئَسَ (istayʔasa)
# أَسْتَيْئِسْ (ʔastayʔis) /ʔas.taj.ʔis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَيْئَسَ (istayʔasa)
